seo_description: Illustrative implementation patterns by region and campus type—honest framing until partner-approved public stories publish.
headline: Patterns from real rollouts—not invented school names.
subheadline: Each card is labeled by country and campus type. We do not publish anonymous placeholder wins or logos without contract. Partner-approved narratives will replace illustrative patterns when available.

segments.title: Publishing standard
segments.body: Public case studies require school consent, legal review, and editorial sign-off—no fabricated metrics on this page.

segments.title: What illustrative means
segments.body: The cards below describe repeatable implementation patterns (governance, admissions, localization)—not unaudited performance guarantees.

segments.title: Talk with us
segments.body: Request a demo or ask about documenting your rollout as an early partner story.
